notes: Stories refined for dependency correctness and contract alignment.

change_log.note: Enrichment depends on schema and core logic

stories.title: Define Provider Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty, filters like insurance and radius, pagination) and outputs (ranked providers, scores, geo metadata, NUCC codes) ensuring strict compatibility with tool_router and FindCareFacade.

stories.title: Implement Vector + Taxonomy Provider Search Logic
stories.description: Implement multi-stage provider search: MongoDB Atlas vector retrieval → deterministic NUCC taxonomy fallback → geo filtering (state/city/county via FIPS) → normalized ranking/scoring, ensuring consistent ordering and fallback behavior.

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCareFacade and API
stories.description: Integrate provider_search_service into FindCareFacade and expose via tool_router (allowlisted tool) and FastAPI entrypoint, including request validation, response shaping, and compatibility with LLM tool-use flow.

stories.title: Integrate Specialty Identification and Query Enrichment
stories.description: Integrate specialty_service (regex + vector NUCC mapping) and embedding_client to enrich user queries (specialty extraction, expansion) prior to provider_search_service execution without duplicating search logic.

stories.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Implement unit tests for ranking, fallback behavior, geo filtering, and edge cases plus integration tests validating full flow from tool_router → FindCareFacade → provider_search_service, including hybrid (vector vs taxonomy) execution paths.
